issues.title: DeepSeek Harness goes open source — and V4 pricing goes time-of-day
issues.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 开源了，V4 定价也改成了错峰计价
issues.excerpt: This week DeepSeek did two things: open-sourced its Harness agent runtime and switched V4 API billing to peak/off-peak tiers. Here's our read on both — what changed, what to read, and what it means for anyone building on DSH.
issues.excerpt_zh: 这一周 DeepSeek 做了两件事：把 Harness agent 运行时开源，以及把 V4 API 改成错峰计价。本期是我们的解读——发生了什么、值得读什么，以及对每个在 DSH 上开发的人意味着什么。
